title: Queen of Gossip
bio: She knows every bit of gossip in the neighborhood. Faster than a text blast.

player_low_cards: OOH they only have a few cards left! Did you see that?!
They're about to win, just saying!
So fast! Are they hiding a dragon in there?

Shh, I'm close, keep it down!
self_winning_soon: This one's a win, I'm posting it in the group chat!
got_ipit: Ay! Why would you block me?! So mean!
Traitor! You did that on purpose!
table_cleared: Oh, it's clear. Let's chat for a bit.
played_big_combo: FIVE CARDS! Did you all see that?!
Combo! I really am the queen!
